page.overview:
What is Force vision?

Force visions, also known as Force premonitions, were an ability of the Force to see into the past, the future, and other places. It was once possessed by all Jedi but grew rare in the final years of the Galactic Republic. Some Sith also experienced Force visions.

Force visions, also known as Force premonitions, were an aspect of the Force, an ability to see into the past, the future and other places. of the past of an object and those who had interacted with it.

Sith, as Force users, were also capable of experiencing Force visions. Some Jedi attributed this to the future constantly being in motion, with the visions merely warning of what could happen. with their visions of the past being useful in hunting down fugitives or gathering evidence.

During the High Republic Era, the Path of the Open Hand, a radical anti-Force wielder cult, was led by the Force-sensitive Elecia Zeveron, who was known to her followers as "the Mother" and hid her own use of the Force. She claimed to receive visions from the Force but, in fact, was little more than a con artist who tried to guide the Path to her own ends.
